newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 70,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 70,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award as much as 70,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
The EU awarded 30,300 tonnes in its last tender on February 26.

"I think the French have put in quite a few bids and the market is holding quite well and the dollar is stronger than I expected," said one trader, who forecast a wide range between 40,000 and 70,000 tonnes.
This week's maximum restitution level was estimated at 43.835 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kilos of sugar after the 44.471 Ecus awarded last week.
Licences are currently valid until the end of August.
